question: Steroid hormone synthesis, lipid synthesis, and chemical detoxification are activities of which of the following?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum -> Steroid hormone synthesis -> Lipid synthesis -> Chemical detoxification -> 95% CHAIN: Peroxisomes -> Chemical detoxification -> 80% CHAIN: Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum -> Protein synthesis -> 95%
analysis: Steroid hormone synthesis, lipid synthesis, and chemical detoxification are activities primarily associated with the smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
